notes.title: New patch, new tunes! The game's updated and the soundtrack is live!
notes.content:
In the new patch, various issues have been fixed and language selection in the menu has been simplified.


You can now purchase the Incelthread soundtrack on Steam if you enjoyed the game!
Support the developer and publisher while gaining the ability to download the tracks via the Steam launcher.


Enjoy listening!
